faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: The things people ask before they buy.

auto.a: You enter a base rate, or explicit buy and sell rates, in the panel. The moment you save, the system pushes the change to your website, Telegram channel and Instagram page.

telegram.q: Can it post to our Telegram channel?
telegram.a: Yes. Telegram publishing is part of the package: formatted text messages and rendered rate images go straight to your channel, and a bot can answer price queries from your customers.

instagram.a: Yes. Rate graphics are generated automatically on your own template and published directly to your page through the Instagram API.

branding.q: Can the posts use our own branding?
branding.a: Yes. Upload your logo, brand colours, fonts and background artwork, and every generated image and page follows your visual identity.

website.q: Do we get a website as well?
website.a: A branded rate page on your domain is included. A full exchange website is available as a separate add-on.

branches.q: Can we manage more than one branch?
branches.a: Yes. Branches can be defined with separate access, and rates are managed centrally. Additional branches are a small one-off add-on.

setup.q: What does the one-off price cover?
setup.a: Server setup, panel installation, security configuration, Telegram and Instagram API connection, template design and staff training. There is no separate setup fee.

api.q: Can you build a custom API for us?
api.a: Yes. As an add-on we can build a custom API that pulls rates from a global source or connects the panel to your accounting software.

support.a: No. Support and maintenance is an optional add-on covering updates, backups, monitoring and priority response. The panel keeps running without it.
